body.x: EVERPONIC Co., Ltd. (CEO Soo Keun Kim) announced its participation in CES 2025 from January 7 to 10 in Las Vegas, showcasing its cutting-edge vertical hydroponic smart farming system within the K-Startup Pavilion.

Founded in November 2024, EVERPONIC specializes in modular container plant factories that integrate ICT technology and automated systems. CEO Soo Keun Kim, an economics graduate from the University of Minnesota, established the company to address challenges in crop production in extreme climates, such as deserts.

EVERPONIC’s smart farm technology enables year-round cultivation of diverse crops regardless of climate, location, or time. Designed for extreme environments, the system optimizes water usage while minimizing its ecological footprint. Central to this solution is a vertical tower structure that maximizes cultivation space and employs a recirculating water system to reduce consumption.

The system also creates an independent environment, insulated from external factors, and features an automated control system for precise environmental management. LED grow lights within the container ensure uniform light distribution, facilitating the easy production of fresh and healthy produce.

EVERPONIC's system is noted for its flexibility and scalability, allowing users to adjust cultivation capacity based on their needs. Vertical hydroponic facilities boost productivity while efficiently using water and resources, making them an environmentally friendly solution.

An EVERPONIC representative highlighted the smart farm’s ICT integration, which allows users to remotely control all internal systems via a proprietary mobile control system. The system monitors real-time environmental and nutrient solution data, enhancing operational convenience. "It’s a user-centric technology designed for accessibility, enabling anyone to operate the system effortlessly," the representative explained.

EVERPONIC’s automated technology and vertical hydroponic system ensure high yields with minimal labor. The system also delivers consistent, high-quality harvests and enables consumers to access fresh produce year-round at reasonable prices through planned cultivation. This approach promotes sustainable agricultural ecosystems, addresses climate crises, global warming, and aging rural populations, and sets a new paradigm for agri-tech.

In addition to maximizing sustainable crop production, EVERPONIC aims to expand eco-friendly cultivation methods through partnerships and collaborations. Domestically, the company has partnered with Haneul Farm to establish a container smart farm in Mungyeong, which is supported by local government grants. Internationally, EVERPONIC collaborates with SAMS GAMES to integrate its smart farming technology with a metaverse gaming platform, enabling customers to cultivate virtual crops and receive real-world deliveries.

EVERPONIC is also launching a youth rental program. In this program, young farmers pay minimal rent and retain all profits from their harvests, supporting economic independence and agricultural innovation.

EVERPONIC’s vertical hydroponic systems are setting new standards for sustainable farming. They offer solutions that benefit growers and consumers while contributing to global ecological and agricultural advancements.

AVING News, which has covered CES for 19 consecutive years, continues to bridge the gap for Korean SMEs and startups looking to expand globally. To promote Korean startups worldwide, AVING will host its Broadcasting Zone at the Venetian Expo, featuring the CES Media Day Startup Conference and global media interviews. AVING’s international media partners will cover these programs.
Following CES 2025, AVING will co-host review conferences with participating companies in Korea, offering a platform for increased visibility and improved corporate image.
